name: domma-js
description: Dynamic Object Manipulation & Modeling API - A complete front-end toolkit.

scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development npm run generate:bundles && rollup -c && node scripts/build-info.js && npm run build:metadata && npm run copy:themes && npm run build:css && npm run build:miniapps && live-server public --port=3001 --open=/index.html
scripts.dev:watch: NODE_ENV=development npm run generate:bundles && rollup -c && node scripts/build-info.js && npm run build:metadata && npm run copy:themes && npm run build:css && npm run build:miniapps && npm run watch:miniapps
scripts.build: npm run generate:bundles && rollup -c && node scripts/build-info.js && npm run build:metadata && npm run copy:themes && npm run build:css && npm run build:css-bundles && npm run build:archives && npm run build:kickstart && npm run build:miniapps
scripts.build:kickstart: npm run build:js && npm run build:info && node scripts/build-kickstart-zip.js
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run release
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run release
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run release

author: Darryl Waterhouse
